blocks.text: Puerto Princesa City — Four people died and another was injured after two motorcycles collided along the national highway in Barangay Sumbiling, Bataraza, Palawan, early Sunday. The Palawan Police Provincial Office said the crash occurred around 2 a.m. when the two motorcycles, traveling at high speed from opposite directions, collided. The fatalities included an 18-year old rider of a blue Rusi 125 and one backrider, both residents of Brgy. Buliluyan in Bataraza, and the rider of the other motorcycle and his backrider, both residents of Brgy. Sumbiling, police said in a report. READ: PCG fends off Chinese vessel, 4 small boats […]...
